battle.unsettled_rejection: {name} is unsettled — Rejection saps its power and speed.
battle.no_effect: {name} uses {move} — it has no effect on {target}. ({why})
battle.thorns: {name} is covered in spines — {target} takes {amount} back.
battle.venom_vehicle: Venom drips off the chassis. Machines remain unimpressed.
battle.stun_immune: {name} has no bedtime. The dart pings off.
battle.bleed: {name} is leaking something. Oil, ichor, morale.
battle.bristle: {name} bristles. Touching it is now a decision.
battle.rally: {name} rallies the whole outfit — everyone stands taller.
battle.taunt: {name} is thoroughly provoked and cannot think about anything else.
battle.anchor_dug_in: {name} digs in — no one is getting punted twice in a row.
battle.anchor_no_bench: {name} skids back but holds the line — no reinforcements to rotate in.
battle.punted: {name} is punted out of formation! {next} scrambles in.
battle.punt_nowhere: {name} staggers but has nowhere to go.
battle.tumbled: {name} is sent tumbling! {next} is shoved onto the field.
battle.asleep: {name} is fast asleep. Adorable. Tactically ruinous.
battle.stun_lost_turn: {name} is stunned and loses the turn!
battle.winding_up: {name} winds up {move} — something enormous is coming.
battle.victory: Victory! The area is yours (pending paperwork).
battle.called_win: {turns} turns. The county's noise ordinance kicks in and {name} is escorted off the premises — the field is yours on points.
battle.called_loss: {turns} turns and the inspectors call it. {name} is still up; your team withdraws on points and files a strongly worded grievance.
battle.team_out: The team is out. Regroup at the lab — the Infirmary awaits.
battle.retreat: You beat a tactical retreat. The kazoo plays taps.
battle.cannon: THWOOMP. The Containment Cannon fires — {name} poofs into the impound queue!

stable.levers: Expand the Surgery Theater, or build more pens — every {per} pens past the first {free} houses a chimera too.
stable.full_theater: The stable holds {cap} and every stall is taken.
stable.full_theater_pending: The stable holds {cap}, and {pending} of them are spoken for.
stable.full_vat: The stable holds {cap} and there is nowhere to put whatever comes out.
stable.full_wing: The stable holds {cap} and a graduate needs somewhere to graduate INTO.

settings.ambience_note: The barn, the lab and the war room each hum their own way under the taps.
settings.haptics_note: A short buzz when a creature goes down, when one is collected, and when a county falls. Nothing else shakes.
settings.volume_full_sub: As loud as it was written
settings.volume_quiet_sub: Just enough to know it happened

dossier.alive: Something of yours is alive. Whoever the county blames for it needs a name.
dossier.door_hint: You can change it later, in your dossier.
dossier.roll_sub: Rolled, not typed — this game does not open the phone keyboard for anybody.
dossier.creed_body: You hold ground now, which means the wire will start quoting you. It would help to know what you were going to say.
dossier.creed_hint: Flavour only — your anatomy is where the mechanics live

board.no_leads: No leads left. The county has to forget you a little before anyone talks again.
